name: China State Shipbuilding Corp.-Systems Engineering Research Institute
zh: 中国船舶集团有限公司系统工程研究院

evidence.summary: The US Entity List names it as “China State Shipbuilding Corp.-Systems Engineering Research Institute”, a research body of China State Shipbuilding Corporation (CSSC). CSSC is one of the state-owned defence-industry groups that SASTIND lists; SASTIND reported at its founding in 2019 that it would carry out the research and production of all the navy’s main combat equipment, including aircraft carriers and nuclear submarines. The US Commerce Department listed it in June 2022 for acquiring and attempting to acquire US-origin items in support of military applications.

It belongs to CSSC, formed in 2019, with the approval of the Party Central Committee and the State Council, by merging the former China State Shipbuilding Corporation and China Shipbuilding Industry Corporation.
